Add cropped pecans or walnuts if desired. Grease and flour a loaf pan and bake for 35-45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
output: To make Banana Bread, first preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Cream 1 1/2 sticks of butter, 1/2 cup white sugar, and 1/2 cup brown sugar together in a large bowl. Add two eggs, beaten and combine. In a Separate bowl, crush four overripe bananas with a potato masher. Add bananas to butter mixture, add 2 teaspoons vanilla.
